name: Streaming Proxy Favors Confidential Proxy Voting With Institutional Dual Holders 21Fd767F2E
text: Proxy favors reports that the reciprocity relationship between firms and institutional dual holders does not exist when confidential proxy voting is in place. This supplies a concrete governance-control mechanism for one conflict channel consistent with Kaal's broader principal-agent misalignment claim. The abstract does not show that confidentiality removes residual agency loss generally.
